sam-sales: Contoso flagged MSA + DPA redlines and procurement needs PO mapping. POC blocked for Monday. Can legal triage? @nina-legal

nina-legal: Quick path: we can accept signed DPA + zero-dollar POC SOW to start. Ask them to upload any MSA redline. DPA: controller instructions + 15-day deletion post-termination.

paul-ops: Ops: PO on invoice required for production. For trial we can run on credits; set SOW amount $0 and include 'PO pending' line. Need W-9 before any paid invoices.

lee-se: Technical: hosted eval supports KMS bridge for trial; Dedicated needed for BYOK. Ask if they require BYOK during trial.

irina-customer: We can sign SOW today and route via DocuSign. PO will be ~2 weeks. Legal will review MSA but OK to start POC.

sam-sales: Plan: send DPA + zero-dollar SOW + SOC2 certs, provision sandbox on sign. I'll post DocuSign envelope id here once sent.

nina-legal: I'll prepare DPA redline and SOW signature routing steps. If they push MSA changes, request their redline and continue POC in parallel.
